---
title: Plane stress and plane strain
---

- Plane stress: No out-of-plane stress
- Plane strain: No out-of-plane strain

:::{.callout-important}
In plane strain, there is in general a non-zero out-of-plane stress component. The same applies for plane stress, there is in general a non-zero strain component.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="false"}
Try a few sets of parameters and see how they compare to the formulas in the lecture notes. Can you make out-of-plane terms disapear?
:::
